data.question: A payslip shows 2,000 GBP gross pay, with 200 GBP income tax, 120 GBP National Insurance, and 100 GBP pension deducted. What is the net (take-home) pay, in GBP?
data.explanation: Net pay is gross minus all deductions: 2,000 - (200 + 120 + 100) = 2,000 - 420 = 1,580 GBP.

data.question: Your tax-free allowance is 12,570 GBP and you earn 20,000 GBP this year. How much of your income is actually subject to income tax, in GBP?
data.explanation: Only income above the allowance is taxed: 20,000 - 12,570 = 7,430 GBP.

title: What to Do If You've Been Scammed

data.question: You have just been scammed. Drag these three actions into the order you should do them, from first (top) to last.

items.label: Report it to the official fraud or police service
Contact your bank to stop or reverse the payment
Change any passwords that may be exposed

data.explanation: Speed protects your money, so contact your bank first; then secure your accounts by changing exposed passwords; then report it to help stop the scammer and support any refund.
